name: How long does it take to see results from AI Website Optimization for AEO?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI Website Optimization for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for seeing significant results from AI Website Optimization for AEO can vary. Initial improvements, such as increased appearances in featured snippets, may be noticeable within a few weeks to a few months, especially for highly targeted content. More comprehensive gains in overall AI search visibility and traffic typically take longer, ranging from 3 to 6 months, as search engines re-index and re-evaluate your optimized content. Continuous optimization yields the best long-term outcomes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial AEO results can appear in weeks to a few months, with more comprehensive gains in AI search visibility typically seen within 3 to 6 months of continuous optimization.
